review.title: Current conclusion
review.markdown:
[Margaret Stewart (Stewart-65226)](https://www.wikitree.com/wiki/Stewart-65226)
is the only proposed missing mother from the graph audit with an exposed
transcription capable of direct proof. Her profile cites Glasgow High Kirk
register `1/754` for a **lawful son of George Glasgow and Margaret Steuart**,
with William Howie and David Scherrar as witnesses. The date range and William
Howie association strongly suggest that this is William-992's entry.

The transcription on Stewart-65226 omits the child's name and event date,
however, and William-992 currently cites no baptism at all. Do not attach the
mother from graph structure alone.

Her profile cites Glasgow High Kirk register 1/754 for a lawful son of George Glasgow and Margaret Steuart, with William Howie and David Scherrar as witnesses. The date range and William Howie association strongly suggest that this is William-992's entry. The transcription on Stewart-65226 omits the child's name and event date, however, and William-992 currently cites no baptism at all. Do not attach the mother from graph structure alone.

open_questions.current_conclusion: The bounded FamilySearch Scotland Births and Baptisms query for William Glasgow, 1595–1625, father George, returned 12 entries, all in father roles; none was a principal William child. Returned spelling variants included Glascow, Glassgow and Glasgo. The unrelated Glaincors result was not assigned to a Glasgow. This is coverage of a returned index set, not proof that George had no son William. The previously identified Thomas 1612 baptism is not transferred to William. Father 43% remains unchanged.
